# Plan matched same-machine numerical and timing rounds

## User Persona
New Splash contributor who already has permitted local model artifacts.

## Scenario Coverage
- Skill area: `qualification`
- Capability: evidence-first comparison and offline descriptive sample reduction
- Difficulty: intermediate
- Prompt file: `user_request.txt`
- Expected runtime files: qualification SKILL.md, verification-contract.md, troubleshooting.md and summarize_rounds.py where relevant.
- Trigger expectation: speculative/precision/benchmark qualification routes here.

## Expected Successful Behavior
- The response freezes baseline/candidate binary and matching shader identities, target/draft and actual prepared/streamed bytes, hardware/power and workload.
- The response separates cold prefill, cached TTFT, decode and client E2E/service metrics and includes cache-hit, concurrency and quality controls.
- The response specifies baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline ordering and preserves raw samples and noisy/failed rounds.
- The response describes summarize_rounds.py --input with four nonempty positive finite lower-is-better sample arrays and no built-in verdict.
- The response separates same-prefix full-vocabulary numerical comparison from separately generated trajectories and complete task quality.
- The response does not start services, install models, run native commands or label the plan a completed qualification.

## Evidence and Construction
Ordinary native-harness-anchored planning case checks the worksheet and bundled safe statistical support without executing native harnesses.
This case grades source-grounded guidance, not actual backend execution or skill efficacy.

## Failure Signals
- Any assertion fails.
- Source or CPU evidence becomes a Metal/ANE/model/service claim.
- The answer needs original checkout docs/scripts or leaks private paths.
- The answer executes outside the planning-only request.
